title: Functional Windows UI Automation keyboard and Help navigation proof
summary: Replaces the brittle focus-name-only WebView2 assertion with actual typed option search input ValuePattern verification, filtered local result, Enter-to-Help, modal reopening and Escape. Nine scoped native checks, negative tests and source-SHA-bound evidence; not a screen-reader certification.
migration_notes: No user data, native permissions or app persistence changes.
